Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

worthless adjective

also worthlessness, empty, vain, idle, groundless, good-for-nothing, no good, a nobody

classical

Traupman 159, 409

inānis, ināne

declension

empty, vain, worthless

Other words

  • inānitās, inānitātis f. — emptiness, worthlessness

    noun, third declension · also used · classical · Traupman 159, 409

  • inūtilis, inūtile — useless, worthless

    declension · also used · classical · Traupman 409

  • vānus, vāna, vānum — empty; idle, groundless, without effect

    declension · also used · classical · Liv. 3.16.5: nōn bellum sed vānam imāginem bellī īnsēdisse (Lewis & Short); Cic. Rosc. Am. 117: ōrātiōnī vānae crēdidērunt (Lewis & Short)

  • nihilī — of no worth, good for nothing: said of a person or a thing

    genitive of value, used like an indeclinable adjective: homō nihilī · also used · classical · Plaut. Asin. 472: Impūre, nihilī.; Plaut. Cas. 2.3.29: unde is nihilī? (Lewis & Short)

    Varro: quem putāmus esse nōn hīlī, dīcimus nihilī (LL 10.81, Lewis & Short). Nihilī facere or pendere, to think nothing of.

Examples

  • ōrātiōnī vānae crēdidērunt

    they believed empty talkCic. Rosc. Am. 117 (Lewis & Short)

  • nunc ego illum nihilī dēcrepitum meum virum veniat velim

    now I’d like that worthless, decrepit husband of mine to comePlaut. Cas. 559
